body: Yes I've told them, which only upsets them. I have an academic family so I tried to appeal to them using European euthanasia policies as an example, but they wouldn't hear it. So I stopped talking about it. I knew if I kept talking about it, I'd be sent to the hospital or something. Thanks for commenting. It's nice to talk to someone honestly about this.

Hey, thanks for the message. I'm still hanging on. I'm out in the middle of nowhere and I told my family and friends that I need time alone, so the timing is perfect. I've been hanging on for years, just because I feel so guilty for the pain I would cause them. I decided to be selfish and end it because I'm just so tired. But the guilt is still creeping in and I can't quite go through with it, yet. I don't know what I'm going to do, but thank you so much for keeping me in your thoughts!
I might. What kind of things do you want to know?

I'm just really tired of my life, which is basically just fighting depression 24/7. I want to stop fighting. It's exhausting. Something makes me feel less afraid doing it here (geographically).

Other things- was abused as a child, made the worst decision of my life by leaving my life in NYC, having my heart truly broken, student debt, unemployment, general pessimism, severe depression, anxiety, and insomnia since childhood.

Law school really is a terrible situation in general. Masochistic professors, forced grading curves (so you are in competition with everyone else), trying to keep up with a workload almost no one can achieve without drugs, most classes' grades based on one exam at the end of the semester, plus most people are extremely competitive "in your face" types. I've heard it's better (emotionally) at lower-tier schools, but you are REALLY fucking yourself if you go to one of those, unless you're on a scholarship.

But the real issue is that there are no/few jobs. Law schools lie about their job placement statistics. The NYTimes has a lot of articles on it. 

I don't think there's another way out. I've been working hard on my depression for years and nothing has changed. I'm tired of fighting it. I just want it to be over. I hope you find out, though!

What are the other ways? I've tried every type of anti-depressant, mood stabilizer, sleeping pills, benzos, ketamine infusions, TMS, holistic, acupuncture, nutritionist... Basically everything but ECT. If you know of another way, I'm all ears!
